Method of Attack: Used in attacks exploiting CVE-2023-21492 to infect Wi-Fi access points with malware
Deployed as a C++-based Android spyware suite capable of decrypting and extracting data from multiple chat and browser apps
Impacted Systems: Samsung mobile devices running Android 11, 12, and 13
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2023-21492 vulnerability via insertion of sensitive kernel pointer information into log files enabling ASLR bypass
Highly-targeted exploit chains combining Android, iOS, and Chrome flaws
Indicators of Compromise: More than 1000 malicious domains including domains spoofing media websites in multiple countries
